items.label: Extremely Comfortable
items.value: Our Padded Camping Chair is filled with high-density soft cotton on the headrest, backrest and seat cushion and 4mm thick sponge pad support on the hands, which will support for your head, neck, back, waist, and hips, and you can feel the comfort of a sofa outdoors.

items.label: Safe and Sturdy
items.value: The high-density 600D Oxford fabric that we use to make the folding camping chair is weather-resistant, long-lasting, and simple to clean. With its strong, reinforced steel supports—which are 50% thicker than typical—and strengthened safety bolts, Colegence camping chair can carry up to 450 pounds.

items: Foldable and Portable：The portable folding chair requires no assembly and can be opened for use within seconds. The compact structure of the camp chair is lightweight at 13.3 pounds. With a expandable compression carry bag and backpack-style strap allows for easy folding and storage after fishing or any outdoor activity.

items.label: Multiple Storage Spaces
items.value: To make your trip more convenient, we designed cup holder and 2 side pockets on the chair. You can place beverages, books, mobile phones, tablets and other items depending on your needs. This thoughtful design aims to provide you with the best outdoor experience while freeing up your hands.

items.label: IDEAL for Outdoor
items.value: The Outdoor Chair is not only suitable for hiking, camping but is also perfect for outdoor concerts, open-air movie nights, picnics, or for use at home. A variety of stylish colors make the portable chair a fashionable accessory for outdoor activities, adding a touch of brilliance to your camping gear.

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Patio Garden, camping, fishing, lawn, outdoor
